summary: PDR is a privately held third-party logistics provider founded in 2003 and headquartered at 40 Saw Mill Pond Road in Edison, NJ, running pick-and-pack, kitting, assembly, returns and back-office services mainly for beauty/cosmetics brands plus TV-shopping (HSN/QVC), supplement and home-goods clients. It reports 100+ clients, 20+ assembly lines and 300+ full-time staff across six Edison buildings (600,000+ sq ft) plus warehouses in Fort Worth, TX and Valencia, CA. In September 2026 it brought a 150,000 sq ft Toronto facility live on the same order systems as Edison, making it a four-region network run on a Microsoft Dynamics ERP and Order Desk order management stack.

facts.fact: Founded in 2003 as the primary distribution center for two clients using 3-4 assembly lines; now 100+ clients, 20 assembly lines, six sites in Edison NJ and more than 300 full-time associates, with NJ facilities covering 600,000+ sq ft.

Service menu covers warehousing, pick and pack, assembly, fulfillment, labeling, packaging, freight forwarding, returns processing, shipping and transportation management, with stated experience in cosmetics and long-standing work for TV shopping networks including HSN and QVC.

Warehouse addresses are 40 Saw Mill Pond Road, Edison NJ (East Coast), 1701 East Altamesa Blvd Suite 150, Fort Worth TX (South) and 29025 Avenue Paine, Valencia CA (West Coast); corporate phone 732.316.2757 and email info@pdrnj.com.

PDR's Toronto operation (150,000 sq ft) became fully operational in September 2026 after systems testing with Edison, and the company says it is working with a freight-forwarding partner to add a bonded component in Canada.
PDR uses Microsoft Dynamics ERP to manage each client's business and integrates with over 30 front-end platforms, supported by in-house programmers and EDI experts.
PDR works with Order Desk order management software to manage multi-channel orders and custom automation for e-commerce customers.
Pricing is not published: prospects must download a New Customer Questionnaire (Excel file) and email the completed form to info@pdrnj.com for a personalized quote.

Back-office solutions offered to clients include supply chain management, accounts receivable and collections, cash management, accounts payable, payroll processing, benefits management, general ledger, financial reporting and audit support.
The company site lists 'Dock to Stock in 48 Hours' as an operating commitment and names automation including mobile robots, vertical lift modules, flow rack lines and conveyor systems.

A 2020 expansion added a 114,000 sq ft Edison facility with 18 assembly lines and 40-foot ceilings, alongside a new ERP system and a workforce increase of 15% in operations, customer service, assembly production and receiving.
PDR publishes a 2026 holiday closure calendar (11 holiday dates) and a general status notice for employees in place of standard business hours.

The staff page lists 'over 250 full-time employees' and names functional roles including Order Processing Manager, Returns Manager, EDI Analyst, Receiving Manager, Shipping Clerk, Inventory Clerk, Warehouse Transfer Coordinator, Controller, Staff Accountant and Database Administrator.

operations_signals: Inbound demand is handled by phone (732.316.2757) plus a generic web contact form with free-text subject/message fields; no online booking, quote calculator or client portal is exposed on the site (https://www.pdrnj.com/contact/).

Quote/onboarding is a manual document loop: prospect downloads an Excel 'New Customer Questionnaire', fills it out offline and emails it to info@pdrnj.com, after which pricing is prepared (https://www.pdrnj.com/pricing/).

No published business hours; the operating-schedule page instead posts a 2026 holiday closure list and a daily 'normal business hours today' style status line for staff (https://www.pdrnj.com/operating-schedule/).

Service area is now four-region: Edison NJ (East Coast), Fort Worth TX (South), Valencia CA (West Coast) and Toronto, Ontario (https://www.pdrnj.com/contact/, https://www.pdrnj.com/pdr-expands-operations-into-canada-with-fully-operational-toronto-fulfillment-facility/).
Dock-to-stock is promised at 48 hours, implying receiving/putaway workflows measured in days rather than hours (https://www.pdrnj.com/automation/).

Order intake runs through Order Desk order management software integrated with 30+ sales channels, so exceptions, edits and multi-channel order issues flow into a manual operations queue (https://www.pdrnj.com/services/e-commerce-fulfillment/).

PDR sells outsourced back-office work (AR/collections, AP, payroll, GL, financial reporting) to clients, meaning accounting and collections activity sits inside its own operations (https://www.pdrnj.com/services/back-office-solutions/).

After-hours coverage is not advertised; a Night Shift Manager role exists in the org chart, which suggests multiple shifts but no published 24/7 client support line (https://www.pdrnj.com/our-people/).
hiring_signals: No careers, jobs or employment page exists anywhere in the site's navigation or sitemap; the only hiring-adjacent contact is an HR email used for health/safety notices (https://www.pdrnj.com/page-sitemap.xml, https://www.pdrnj.com/operating-schedule/).

SimplyHired returns zero current listings for 'Packaging Distribution Resources' in Edison, NJ, indicating no active public postings indexed there at time of research (https://www.simplyhired.com/search?q=Packaging+Distribution+Resources&l=Edison%2C+NJ).

Historical hiring was volume-heavy and non-exempt: the 2020 expansion added 15% headcount across operations, customer service, assembly production and receiving (https://njbmagazine.com/njb-news-now/packaging-distribution-resources-expands-operations/).

Headcount is stated inconsistently on the company's own pages - 'more than 300 full-time associates' on the About page versus 'over 250' on the staff page - suggesting rapid, recently updated growth (https://www.pdrnj.com/about-us/, https://www.pdrnj.com/our-people/).

Org chart is dense with manual coordination and clerical titles - Order Processing Manager, Returns Manager, Warehouse Transfer Coordinator, Inventory Clerk, Shipping Clerks, EDI Analyst, Operations and Special Projects Coordinator - which are the roles most exposed to automation (https://www.pdrnj.com/our-people/).
review_themes: No public customer reviews were retrievable: Sitejabber shows the domain with zero reviews and a 0.0 rating, and Yelp/Yelp-style and Trustpilot pages returned access blocks (https://www.sitejabber.com/reviews/pdrnj.com).

The only client-voice evidence is self-published: PDR attributes its growth mainly to word-of-mouth and publishes a logo wall of roughly 45 beauty and consumer brands as its client roster (https://www.pdrnj.com/about-us/, https://www.pdrnj.com/hs/).
tech_footprint: Microsoft Dynamics ERP as the core client-level system of record, plus 30+ front-end sales-channel integrations and in-house EDI and custom reporting (https://www.pdrnj.com/pdr-technology/).
Order Desk order management platform used for multi-channel order edits, bundling and fulfillment rules (https://www.pdrnj.com/services/e-commerce-fulfillment/).
Warehouse automation described at a category level: mobile robots, vertical lift modules, flow rack inventory lines and conveyor systems (https://www.pdrnj.com/automation/).

Website is WordPress with the All in One SEO plugin; there is no chat widget, no booking widget, no client login and no careers module visible in the page source or sitemap (https://www.pdrnj.com/, https://www.pdrnj.com/sitemap.xml).

Content is thin and stale in places: only four blog/news posts total, with most service and industry pages last modified in 2023 while About/Our People were refreshed in 2026 (https://www.pdrnj.com/post-sitemap.xml).
Marketing asset library is a client logo wall plus downloadable pricing questionnaire, not published data or self-serve tools (https://www.pdrnj.com/pricing/, https://www.pdrnj.com/hs/).
growth_signals: Toronto facility went live in September 2026 at 150,000 sq ft, PDR's first site outside the U.S., with systems integration tested against Edison (https://www.pdrnj.com/pdr-expands-operations-into-canada-with-fully-operational-toronto-fulfillment-facility/).

The Toronto launch is explicitly framed around tariffs, trade policy uncertainty and cross-border inventory positioning, with a bonded/freight-forwarding component planned next (https://www.pdrnj.com/pdr-expands-operations-into-canada-with-fully-operational-toronto-fulfillment-facility/).

Footprint grew from four Edison buildings (~320,000 sq ft) in 2020 to six Edison sites totaling 600,000+ sq ft today (https://njbmagazine.com/njb-news-now/packaging-distribution-resources-expands-operations/, https://www.pdrnj.com/about-us/).

Client base and industry mix broadened beyond cosmetics into pet products, toys, nutritional supplements, clothing and PPE, and PDR added an ERP in 2020 partly to serve client demand planning/forecasting requests (https://www.pdrnj.com/industries-served/, https://njbmagazine.com/njb-news-now/packaging-distribution-resources-expands-operations/).
PDR runs community/charity activity (2025 ALS Polar Plunge team), a mild signal of employer-brand investment but not of capacity growth (https://www.pdrnj.com/in-the-news/).
decision_maker: Jack Sandbach, Founder & CEO — listed as CEO on https://www.pdrnj.com/our-people/, described as Founder & CEO in NJB Magazine (https://njbmagazine.com/njb-news-now/packaging-distribution-resources-expands-operations/) and quoted as CEO in the company's September 2026 Toronto release

inferences.inference: Client acquisition is gated by a manual questionnaire-and-email process, so quote turnaround likely depends on individual staff availability rather than a standardized intake.
inferences.reasoning: The only published pricing path is downloading an .xlsx questionnaire and emailing it to a general inbox; there is no form logic, estimator or CRM hand-off visible on the site (pricing and contact pages).

inferences.inference: Inbound inquiry triage (calls, generic inbox, contact-form spam) is a plausible AI agent win because all three channels land in one small administrative group with no ticketing system in evidence.
inferences.reasoning: Contact page offers a single phone number and a single form routed to info@; the staff page shows client relations, order processing and accounting as separate small roles rather than a service desk, and no help-desk or chat tooling is visible.

inferences.inference: The Toronto launch will increase coordination load on Edison rather than reduce it, because the new site runs the same systems and workflows with no indication of added corporate headcount.
inferences.reasoning: The release emphasizes identical systems/workflows across sites and same-team service; headcount figures on the site (250 vs 300+) are inconsistent, and no new corporate roles are advertised.

inferences.inference: Recruiting is likely referral- and walk-in-driven, so hiring volume is invisible to job-board analytics.
inferences.reasoning: No careers page exists in the sitemap or navigation, SimplyHired shows zero postings, and the site publishes an HR email only for employee health/safety notices.

inferences.inference: Manual EDI/integration mapping is a bottleneck the company is aware of and has chosen to staff around rather than automate.
inferences.reasoning: The technology page highlights in-house programmers and EDI experts plus 30+ platform integrations, and the org chart names a single EDI Analyst role for that load.

inferences.inference: Customer-service quality claims cannot be verified externally, so any pitch should be framed around internal throughput and response-time metrics rather than reputation repair.
inferences.reasoning: No public review corpus exists for the company; the only satisfaction claims are self-published on the marketing site.

data_gaps: No public customer reviews found; Google, Yelp, Trustpilot and BBB pages were blocked, bot-challenged or empty, so no review themes could be sourced.

No current job postings located: Indeed, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter, Glassdoor and Jooble were blocked or bot-challenged, and SimplyHired returned zero results; exact open roles and headcount plans are unknown.
No published business hours, after-hours support terms or SLA documentation beyond the 'Dock to Stock in 48 Hours' marketing line.
Headcount conflict on the company's own pages (250+ vs 300+ full-time), and no revenue, ownership structure or client-concentration data (private company).
No third-party press coverage of the 2026 Toronto launch was accessible; NJBIZ and ROI-NJ searches returned no matching articles or were blocked.

Web search providers (Exa, OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral) and several search engines failed or rate-limited during this run, so coverage relies on direct fetches of the company site, its sitemap, NJB Magazine and SimplyHired; additional review or hiring sources may exist but could not be reached.
